selected_evidence.requirement: datauser account limited to 100MB under /srv/data, filesystem-enforced
selected_evidence.summary: Discovered no existing /srv/data or datauser; created datauser, built a dedicated XFS loop filesystem at /srv/data with prjquota, and correctly configured /etc/projid (name:projid) and /etc/projects (projid:path) for project-based quota mapping

selected_evidence.requirement: Quota enforcement proof (filesystem itself rejects writes past 100MB)
selected_evidence.summary: sudo -u datauser dd wrote 60MB successfully, then a second 60MB write failed with 'No space left on device' after exactly 40MB (bringing total to 100MB), and xfs_quota report confirmed datauser used=100M hard=100M

selected_evidence.requirement: Quota persists across mount cycle (pre-restart sanity)
selected_evidence.summary: Unmounted and remounted /srv/data; xfs_quota report still shows the 100M limit for datauser after remount
Captured boot_id bfd05127-56aa-4657-b540-847a25f90491, confirmed /srv/data mounted with prjquota, quota limits active, and a live 10MB write by datauser succeeded

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && reboot' so the exec call returned 'reboot-scheduled' before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: First poll hit a connection reset (node down mid-reboot); next poll succeeded with a new boot_id 594178a7-313a-4411-915b-9bdcc770c7ab and uptime of 5s, proving a real reboot occurred (boot_id changed from baseline)

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of /srv/data, quota, and data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, /srv/data was auto-remounted via fstab with prjquota, the pre-reboot healthcheck file was intact, quota report still showed the 100M limit, a 50MB write succeeded, and a subsequent 60MB write failed at exactly 100MB used with ENOSPC, proving quota enforcement survived the restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Final cleanup leaving quota configured and /srv/data ready for use
selected_evidence.summary: Removed all test files; final state shows /srv/data empty, owned by datauser, with the 100MB project quota still configured and active
